body.estimand_functional: \(C(p)=H(\theta)/K(\theta)\) for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)\ne\varnothing\) and every \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\)

sampling_model.design: A fixed finite menu \(\mathcal R\) of observational and perfect-interventional regimes is supplied; symbolic identification is uniform over its full feasible image.
sampling_model.units: For inference, regime \(r\) supplies \(n_r\) i.i.d. finite-alphabet draws, independently across regimes.
sampling_model.treatment: Each regime clamps a declared endogenous subset \(Z\) to \(z\) and records the complete joint outcome on \(V\setminus Z\).
sampling_model.overlap: Evaluation separates infeasible menu vectors from feasible vectors having no positive-denominator model.  Inference assumes positive limiting regime fractions and a fixed positive margin for every circuit divisor.  Its variance threshold satisfies \(\kappa_n\to0\) and \(\delta_n/\kappa_n\to0\); the proof establishes the simultaneous matrix rate \(\lVert\widehat\Sigma_Q-\Sigma_Q\rVert=O_P(\delta_n)=o_P(\kappa_n)\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No infinite-dimensional nuisance is estimated.  Empirical multinomial cells pass through a verified rational circuit by automatic differentiation; symbolically constant coordinates are exact, and nonsymbolic zero first-order variance coordinates are reported without Wald studentization.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Algorithms 1--2 and Theorems 5--6 are sound and complete for marginal and conditional counterfactual identification from arbitrary observational and experimental inputs in recursive acyclic SCMs.
Theorem 9.10 proves soundness of an extended ID algorithm for cyclic ioSCM interventional effects, and Remark 9.11 makes no completeness claim.
Theorem 2.4 gives finite canonical acyclic SCMs, and the paper reduces counterfactual bounds to polynomial optimization.
The inflation hierarchy converges asymptotically to the compatible set for finite latent causal structures.
Theorem 2 and Corollary 1 characterize source-aligned influence functions and canonical gradients for prespecified smooth data-fusion targets.

body.tldr: Finite-alphabet simple SCMs make feedback counterfactuals well defined, but the cyclic formula-or-countermodel completeness step remains open.  \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\) is a deterministic cycle-label- and source-incidence-preserving recursion on explicit legal response tables.  The proved operational theorem gives termination, exact evaluation statuses, valid rational formulas whenever a verified circuit is emitted, and valid same-alphabet same-source-incidence countermodels whenever a certificate is emitted and accepted.  The unresolved converse has exactly two parts: rational descent on every legal positive source fiber and nonvanishing transmission of every local separator through all recursive boundary interfaces.  Returned regular circuits nevertheless compile to proved multinomial influence functions and threshold-valid simultaneous Gaussian regions, with exact symbolic constants and first-order degenerate coordinates reported separately.

project_justification.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 proves complete conditional counterfactual identification for recursive SCMs, while BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies cyclic simple-SCM semantics and ForreMooij2020 proves sound cyclic interventional identification.  None proves source-aware rational descent and universal same-class countermodel transmission for cyclic Layer-3 queries.
project_justification.niche: One induced chordless cycle per consolidated district permits nontrivial feedback and sparse confounding while admitting exact legality enumeration, preserved cycle labels, and finite source-polynomial elimination.
project_justification.fill: SC-CTFID combines conditional counterfactual cancellation with an ordered cyclic recursion, explicit source-aware real and Groebner elimination, exact certificate replay, and boundary-interface bookkeeping.  The current result proves termination and the soundness of every verified positive or negative output, isolates the two missing implications needed for completeness, and supplies automatic fixed-dimensional inference for every returned regular circuit.

body.related_work: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Theorems 5--6, supplies the complete acyclic CTFID base and conditional cancellation.  BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies simple-SCM solvability and intervention semantics, while ForreMooij2020 gives sound cyclic interventional identification but not Layer-3 completeness.  ZhangTianBareinboim2022 informs finite response parametrization, and NavascuesWolfe2020 together with WolfeSpekkensFritz2019 shows why independent latent sources impose compatibility restrictions beyond unrestricted legal response-table mixtures.  LeeSpekkens2017 demonstrates exact algebraic recovery only in selected small structures.  Those results support the verified terminal operations but do not establish the two still-open steps here: one rational representative on every positive sparse-source image and universal source-preserving boundary transmission.  LiLuedtke2023 informs the multi-regime influence-function calculation, while Tikka2023 identifies cfid as the direct software consumer.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The explicit response and source tables may already be exponentially larger than the graph, and no succinct-input efficiency claim is made.  More importantly, completeness is not yet proved: the obstruction \(O\) has not been excluded on every legal sparse-source positive fiber, and a locally nonzero separator has not been shown to retain a nonzero target contrast through every exterior interface.  The inference theorem is fixed-dimensional and pointwise on positive-margin strata; nonsymbolic zero first-order variance coordinates are deliberately reported without a Wald interval.
body.honest_scope: The established claims are exact cycle legality, source-preserving finite compression in the frozen core, selected source-realizability calculations, intervention closure, conditional boundary gluing when a transmitting assignment is supplied, termination, one-way circuit soundness, verifier soundness of accepted negative certificates, exact evaluation statuses, and regular multinomial circuit inference.  Computational enumeration remains evidence rather than a general proof.  The headline formula-or-same-class-countermodel equivalence remains open until rational descent is proved for every legal positive source fiber and every satisfiable local separator is shown to possess a nonvanishing recursive transmission.  A legal terminal producing a genuinely algebraic nonrational identified value, or a local separator annihilated by every exterior interface, would refute the current completeness contract.
